text: Confirmed and filed #6583: VFP9 SP2 `COPY FILE source.bin TO copied.bin` copies a 4-byte fixture (including embedded NUL); Copperfin current-source path evaluates both bare operands and errors without creating the destination. Quoted control works and copies exact bytes. Language Reference explicitly documents `COPY FILE FileName1 TO FileName2` and wildcard operands. Existing runtime host build predates HEAD by minutes, but the intervening dispatch change only touches SET FILTER; COPY FILE parser/dispatch blocks are unchanged. Issue open, owner-authored, labels bug/runtime/agent-approved. No production changes.
